text:
DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION SCIENCE
GLOBAL INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Arun Rajendra Kumar, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2020-2024) at Global Institute of Science & Engineering.

During this tenure, Arun Rajendra Kumar demonstrated exceptional mastery in Computer Vision, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Edge AI. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Real-Time Deep Learning for Autonomous Mobile Perception', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Arun Rajendra Kumar displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Arun Rajendra Kumar among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram
Associate Professor
Information Science
Global Institute of Science & Engineering
Email: .meenakshi.sundaram@globalinst.edu
